escena: SCENE (a bare desk in a dark empty modern office at night, seen straight on at desk height): standing ON TOP of an ultra-low-profile aluminium keyboard with flat chiclet keys and no visible frame, the small Gigi figure from the reference holds its megaphone raised and turned AWAY from the camera towards the empty dark room, mid-announcement. The keycaps are clearly LARGER than the figure's feet, so it reads unmistakably as a physical figurine about 25 cm tall. To the right, angled towards it, a large bezel-less display shows one single rounded ANSWER CARD glowing on a dark field — a plain empty rounded rectangle with a short bright underline beneath it and nothing else: no letters, no numbers, no words, no icons, no interface chrome. That display is the ONLY light source: it rakes hard across the flat keys picking out their edges, lights one side of the figure and leaves the other falling to black. The room it announces into is completely empty and unlit — no people, no chairs, no other screens, nothing listening. Fine dust hangs in the light. The figure is the ONLY colour in the frame. 50mm lens at f/2.8, camera at keyboard height. NOTHING IN THIS SCENE MAY READ AS OLD OR ANALOGUE. Absolutely NO books, NO bound volumes, NO paper, NO plants, NO mugs, NO pencil cups, NO clutter of any kind anywhere in frame, including out of focus in the background. Every object is current-generation hardware with clean machined surfaces: anodised aluminium, matte glass, seamless edges. Screens are bezel-less, edge to edge. The desk is bare except for what the scene names. The room behind is empty architectural darkness, not a cosy study. FRAMING FOR THIS FORMAT: the keyboard runs across the LOWER third of the frame and the figure stands on it near the bottom; the empty dark room rises tall and unbroken above for most of the frame height, and the megaphone is raised UPWARD into that emptiness. SIGNATURE BAND (essential): a horizontal band running the FULL width of the frame between 54% and 66% of the frame height is completely EMPTY, unlit and evenly dark — no object, no edge, no highlight, no light beam and no part of the subject enters it, and no bright surface sits behind it. It keeps faint material texture and is never a flat pure-black panel. Everything in the scene sits either ABOVE or BELOW that band.

texto.muro: the empty dark office wall above the desk, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the desk in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near-black oak in deep shadow, matte, its grain still faintly visible, outside the light
